entries.original: Three `rg` examples used `rg -iE`. In ripgrep `-E` is `--encoding`, not a pattern-type flag, so the combined form consumes the next argument and the examples did not do what they claimed; they now use `rg -i`.

One `refactor` guidance line told an agent to fall back from `deep`; that category was split into `deep-low` / `deep-high`, so it now names `deep-high`. ([#12615](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12615))

`thread_send` and `thread_handoff` to a session on another device no longer read the session's state before the prompt: the prompt goes out first as a follow-up, and the other device's engine decides whether it starts a turn or waits behind the running one. On today's engines a send takes two sequential relay round trips instead of three: the prompt, then one state read for the started turn's id (idle session) or for the queue position (busy session). A send that starts a turn drops to one round trip once the other device's engine carries senpi#6135 (which fixes senpi#5999). A send that arrives while the other session has claimed a turn but not yet started it now answers `queued` instead of failing as `unsupported`. A steer still reads the session's state first. ([#12679](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12679))

The `visualize`, `data-scientist` and `frontend` skills now teach how to build a chart page shown inline beside a reply. Figures are computed at their source (SQL in the database the data lives in, DuckDB or Polars over files). An inline chart is drawn in HTML instead of a matplotlib PNG, with `:root { color-scheme: light dark; }` so `light-dark()` fallbacks follow the theme. Bars are HTML elements in a fixed-height container, the first and last axis labels are aligned to the chart edges so neither clips at 390 px, days are cut in the reader's time zone with a partial day marked on its own bar, and one figure is cross-checked against a second source. The preview step now measures each chart's largest bar and legend colours in dark and light at the reply width and 390 px. `frontend` exempts an inline page from its `DESIGN.md` gate, Lighthouse audit and research lanes, which `visualize` already assumed. ([#12612](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12612))

entries.original: The desktop engine protocol gains an opt-in action-report vocabulary on protocol 1, with no version or ABI change. `engine.hello` lists `features: ["action-report"]`, and a session opened with `reportMode: "object"` gets an `ActionReport` from every mutating request. The report says whether input reached the target and whether retrying is safe: one of seven `{delivery, retry}` pairs. Errors from those requests carry the same `disposition`. Sessions that don't opt in see the same replies as before, apart from the new `features` list. The protocol also gains the error codes `AmbiguousTarget`, `CaptureConsentRequired` and `ProtectedProcess`, the `epoch.changed` notification, and optional window-identity and accessibility-evidence fields that later changes will fill in. Frame ids are now unique per engine process, so a frame id from before a session re-open can never match a new capture. ([#12260](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12260), part of [#12234](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12234))

entries.original: omo Native eval cells can reach this user's machines through the bunshin TypeScript SDK: the plugin bundles `@sisyphuslabs/bunshin-ts` and `@sisyphuslabs/bunshin-ts-relay` (vendored build output pinned per file, not npm dependencies) into `runtime/bunshin-ts/sdk.js`, publishes its directory as `OMO_BUNSHIN_TS_SDK_ROOT` at activation, and the installer requires it. `pickTransport` (`BUNSHIN_TS_TRANSPORT` = `auto`, `relay` or `hub`) uses the local device service when it reports connected; this build bundles no hub transport. Over the relay, one device that is slow, offline or refused on `machine.describe` no longer fails `connect()`, `listMachines()` or `fanout()` for every machine: it is listed `unsupported` with `attention` naming why and after how long, fanout skips it, and the device the cell runs on is listed too (unsupported, since the service runs no machine operation on its own device). A `bunshin` skill pointer and removed-tool hint teach the import. ([#12258](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12258), fixes [#12251](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12251))
